extracted.intended_audience: short-story authors, editors, and readers using the Yearbook (compilers/users of American short-story publications, 1918)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidelines and editorial notes for compiling a Yearbook of American short stories (January–October 1918), including the scope of magazine/address listings and the rules for the Biographical Roll of Honor.

rubrics_metrics.name: Addresses list scope
rubrics_metrics.description: This address list does not aim to be complete, but is based simply on the magazines which I have considered for this volume.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Compiler's note: the addresses included reflect only the magazines the compiler reviewed for this volume; users should not assume exhaustiveness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Magazine inclusion (publishing short stories)
rubrics_metrics.description: ADDRESSES OF AMERICAN MAGAZINES PUBLISHING SHORT STORIES
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The section lists addresses of magazines that publish short stories (as considered by the compiler); inclusion implies the magazine was considered relevant to the Yearbook's scope.

rubrics_metrics.name: Temporal coverage
rubrics_metrics.description: The Yearbook of the American Short Story, January to October, 1918
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The compilation and selection apply to stories and magazine activity occurring within the period January–October 1918; material outside that timeframe is out of scope.

rubrics_metrics.name: Biographical Roll inclusion: American authors only
rubrics_metrics.description: Only stories by American authors are listed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Roll of Honor and biographical listings exclude non-American authors; this is an explicit inclusion filter for entries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best sixty stories marking
rubrics_metrics.description: The best sixty stones are indicated by an asterisk before the title of the story.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: An asterisk marks those stories judged among the top sixty for the period; no further scoring explanation is provided on this page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Index figures denote prior Rolls of Honor inclusion
rubrics_metrics.description: The index figures I, 2, 2, and 4 prefixed to the name of the author indicate that his work has been included in the Rolls of Honor for 1914, 1915, 1916, and 1917 respectively.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Numeric prefixes next to author names signal prior-year inclusions in the Rolls of Honor; use these to track repeat recognition across years.

rubrics_metrics.name: Exclusion of reprints
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Entries in the Biographical Roll and the Yearbook exclude reprinted stories; only original (non-reprint) publications are eligible for listing here.
